title: Website — the new logo in the header, footer and browser tab

steps.path: The bar across the top of youcoded.ai, in five of the site's themes
steps.headline: The top bar now shows the app icon and lowercase "youcoded", in each theme's own colours.
steps.changed: The robot tile and "YOUCODED ASSISTANT / AGENTS FOR EVERYONE" in caps are replaced by the approved logo: the glass app icon and "youcoded" in Outfit. The icon and the name's colours change with the theme picked on the page.
steps.measured: Icon 36 px (32 px on a phone); name 72% of the icon's height, a quarter of the icon apart
steps.notice: The word "Assistant" and the tagline are gone from the bar, as on the approved board. The tab title and share text still say "YouCoded Assistant".
steps.risk: Halftone Dimension's name colours (pink to blue) were never on a board; I picked them from its icon face the same way as the others. Midnight has no icon of its own, so it wears the default, as in the app.

steps.path: The card at the very bottom of the page, on a computer (light and dark theme)
steps.headline: The footer shows the logo with "agents for everyone" tucked beside the y's tail.
steps.changed: The old robot tile and "YouCoded Assistant" become the approved side-by-side logo with tagline, using the round 26 spacing.
steps.measured: Icon 52 px; tagline a third of the name's size
steps.notice: Same icon and colours as the top bar, so the page's two logos finally match.

steps.path: The same footer in a dark theme (Golden Sunbreak)
steps.headline: On dark themes "coded" and the tagline turn light so they stay readable.
steps.changed: "coded" takes the theme's own text colour and the tagline its soft text colour; "you" keeps the theme's gradient.
steps.notice: This follows the approved "on dark" logo version.

steps.path: The footer on a phone, light and dark
steps.headline: On a phone the footer logo fits with the Open Source badge beside it.
steps.changed: The badge moved right to make room for the wider logo. It also fixes today's site, where the badge sits on top of "ASSISTANT" on a phone.
steps.measured: Logo 205 px wide; the badge starts 15 px after it on a 390 px screen
steps.notice: Nothing wraps or overlaps at phone width.
steps.risk: On the narrowest phones (320 px wide) the badge may drop onto its own line.

steps.path: The icon in the browser tab, light and dark browser, five themes
steps.headline: The browser tab shows the app icon, and it follows the theme picked on the page.
steps.changed: The coloured robot square becomes the app icon (the small-size drawing with bigger eyes). iPhones saving the site to the home screen also get the app icon.
steps.measured: 32 px icon file, shown at 16 px
steps.notice: A bookmark keeps the default (Cotton Candy) icon.
steps.risk: At 16 px the white tile is lighter than the old solid square, so it stands out less on a light browser.

steps.path: The picture shown when someone shares youcoded.ai in Messages, Discord, Slack
steps.headline: The link-preview picture is retaken so it shows the new top bar.
steps.changed: Same photo of the page, retaken with the new logo; its cache number moved up so apps fetch the new one.
steps.notice: Links already shared may show the old picture for a few days until those apps refresh.
